meta.title: 🇻🇳Ultimate 7 Days Vietnam Travel Guide✈️ | Best Tourist Places | Complete Budget & Itinerary
meta.description:
Join us as we explore the stunning landscapes and vibrant culture of Vietnam — from war tunnels and ancient towns to scenic beaches and luxury cruises. If you’re planning a Vietnam trip, here’s your perfect day-wise itinerary filled with unforgettable experiences!

📍 Day 1 – Chennai ➝ Singapore ➝ Ho Chi Minh City
We kick off with flights via Singapore and arrive in Vietnam. After check-in, we head to the lively Walking Street for a glimpse of Saigon nightlife.

📍 Day 2 – Mekong Delta Day Trip
A full-day tour through river canals, floating markets, fruit farms & village life. End the day with local shopping at Ben Thanh Market.

📍 Day 3 – Saigon City Tour + Cu Chi Tunnels + Fly to Da Nang
We visit Notre-Dame Cathedral, Post Office, War Museum, then crawl through the Cu Chi Tunnels. Evening flight to Da Nang.

📍 Day 4 – Da Nang Beach + Marble Mountains
Relax at the beach & pool in the morning. Afternoon visit to the beautiful Marble Mountains with caves, pagodas & cliff views.

📍 Day 5 – Ba Na Hills Tour + Night Flight to Hanoi
Ride the world’s longest cable car to Ba Na Hills, walk the iconic Golden Bridge, explore French Village, Fantasy Park & Linh Ung Pagoda. Night flight to Hanoi.

📍 Day 6 & 7 – Halong Bay 2D/1N Cruise
From Hanoi to Halong Bay for a luxury cruise. Visit Luon Cave, kayak, enjoy sunset deck party, and explore Surprising Cave before returning to Hanoi.

✨ From tunnels to temples, rivers to mountains – Vietnam has it all! Like, Comment & Subscribe for more epic adventures.
